messages.text: Why did that trade fail?

It failed on Sacramento’s salary matching, not Chicago’s.

The Kings would take in Josh Giddey’s $25 million salary while sending out only Emanuel Sharp’s $1.36 million. They can receive only about $2.7 million in this exchange, and their payroll would rise above the first apron.

Chicago meets all three of your financial filters: $1.36 million incoming, $23.64 million saved, and $140.05 million payroll afterward. The search found an idea matching those Bulls filters, but that didn’t establish that it worked for Sacramento.
